name: thesis-mcwm-separated-contrast-v13-20261021
trust: Unchanged original action_model trust and eight-update rule; endpoint and 58-column candidates are passive on the same new common trajectory.
selection: Training uses unchanged v10 windows and seed-fixed commands. After the final packet is actually processed, select the first two jointly executable diagnostic issues independently per line, with a separate seed-fixed balanced low/high order.
budget: 57 packets x5 distinct issue slots=285; at most one calibration bundle replaces an ordinary global slot per packet. Several endpoint fields do not create extra supervised issue rows. Zero-duration global slots never enter learned global fitting. Retain456policy updates and24000native seconds per day.
physical_covariate: Reuse fixed102source physical intervals. No extra unbudgeted target physical labels. The new endpoint models use only selected controlled bundles.
endpoint_clock: Action issue and next-stop event delivery use actual native ledger clocks. Native bridge detects an event before finishing its tick, then delivers it one tick later; detection and delivery clocks are recorded separately. Fixed300 is sampled after the exact native tick.
common_prefix: Reproduce v12 full day/preflight sequential native commands, raw/canonical states and global passenger ledger, and all saved old predictions. Every new branch reproduces its new day anchor and all v12 native endpoint truths at the same state, action and external seed.
evaluation: After the actual final budget packet, all parameters freeze. Preserve per-line0/7.5 coverage; predict both actions before feedback. Compare within-endpoint errors and native300-second action gain direction, regret and stable no-harm. Newly paired second states are development diagnostics, not independent confirmation.
scope: Four unchanged-budget common-flow development days, background/action partialling diagnostics, then the same twelve development states and24 native300-second branches. Passive comparators, unchanged trust. No independent confirmation is automatically submitted.

independent_confirmation.gate: Review v12 full-flow/old-prediction and all paired-truth exact reproduction, OOF budget/clock integrity, physical gain decomposition, actual commands and zero suffix training. Then require300-second directional/regret improvement and stable no-harm. No automatic submission.

paired_budget.prefix_replays: Repeated full prefixes and replayed training issue slots are separately counted, never pooled as fresh labels.

residual_baselines.fixed300: Exactly300 seconds; learn wait/ride residuals only.
residual_baselines.same_vehicle_next: Fixed source physical nonholding plus actual holding; global issue-time waiting/onboard rates.
residual_baselines.global_next: Unchanged decoded base world duration plus global issue-time waiting/onboard rates; exact batch-zero override retained.

state_interactions.covariates: All available at issue; no future durations, branch truth or heldout labels used to fit. Existing13cols are retained exactly; baseline already contains global rates and physical duration.
state_interactions.action_difference: Decompose baseline + line holding + each state interaction in physical units; delete interactions at fixed fitted weights without refitting.
state_interactions.fit: Same budget-selected controlled bundles as all comparators; no hyperparameter selection from v11 paired outcomes.

separation.fold_unit: Entire seed-fixed within-line balanced calibration action block. block_index=floor((successful_training_issues_on_line-1)/2), captured at issue before feedback. fold=(block_index+line_index)%2.
separation.background_features: Original13 columns excluding line holding (10 columns), plus global cost rate/1000 and fixed-source nonholding/100.
separation.action_features: u times3line indicators and6existingstate features; u=2hold/7.5-1.
separation.method: Within current released budget-selected training rows only, fit OOF m(Z)->Ybaseline-residual and q(Z)->T on the other fold. Fit beta by ridge on Y-m and T-q; fit gamma on all Y-Tbeta. Predict baseline+Zgamma+Tbeta. Background cancels in the action contrast.
separation.cost_rate_comparators: Full separated9action columns, refit8action columns deleting only globalcost-rate action while retaining it in background; fixed-weight delete the same action contribution. Same rows and same OOF nuisance residuals.
separation.data_scope: No heldout/paired truth training; no increased main labels. Cross-fitting uses only labels already available at the current update; it is a diagnostic regression change, not a causal identification guarantee.
separation.early_support: Without two usable folds keep model unsupported; retain status rather than fabricate nuisance predictions.
